scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.test:py: python3 -m pip install -q -e ./scorer pytest && python3 -m pytest scorer/tests -q
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:py
